title: The authority inventory: every durable write measured, classified and decided
note: Tranche G, G0. Each mutation deletes one rule of tools/authority_inventory.py or blinds its walk to one way a record is written. tests/test_authority_inventory.py pairs each with a synthetic package that passes.

mutations.name: AI1_a_decision_may_be_written_outside_the_lock
mutations.find: if e.get("class") in MUST_DECIDE and have[k]["mode"] != DECIDED:
mutations.rationale: a DECISION or USE appended outside append_decided passes the check

mutations.name: AI2_a_closed_finding_excuses_an_undecided_write
mutations.rationale: a FIXED or absent finding is accepted as the reason a decision is not decided

mutations.name: AI3_an_unclassified_write_passes
mutations.find:
for k in have:
        if k not in listed:
mutations.replace:
for k in have:
        if False:
mutations.rationale: a new writer nobody classified passes the check

mutations.name: AI4_a_stale_entry_passes
mutations.find:
out.append(f"{k} is classified but no such write exists; the "
                       "table describes a past version of the code")
mutations.rationale: the table can describe writers the code no longer has

mutations.name: AI5_a_recorded_mode_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the table may say DECIDED of a write the code appends

mutations.name: AI6_a_duplicate_entry_passes
mutations.find:
if k in listed:
            out.append(f"{k} is classified twice")
mutations.replace:
if False:
            out.append(f"{k} is classified twice")
mutations.rationale: one write classified twice, the second entry shadowing the first

mutations.name: AI7_an_unknown_class_passes
mutations.rationale: a class outside the reviewed vocabulary, which no rule reads, passes

mutations.name: AI8_a_class_with_no_reason_passes
mutations.rationale: a judgement with no stated reason passes

mutations.name: AI9_any_schema_passes
mutations.rationale: a document of another format is checked as though it were this one

mutations.name: AI10_the_walk_misses_a_record_built_elsewhere
mutations.find:

mutations.name: AI11_the_walk_misses_dict_built_records
mutations.rationale: a decided record spelled dict(action=...) has no action, as the scheduler's and the store's are

mutations.name: AI12_the_walk_credits_a_writer_with_its_callees
mutations.find:
if acts or scopes is None:
        return acts
mutations.replace:
if scopes is None:
        return acts
mutations.rationale: a writer that calls another writer is credited with that writer's action

mutations.name: AI13_the_walk_misses_a_deciding_helper
mutations.find: elif name in DECIDING_HELPERS and any(k.arg == "action"
mutations.rationale: the scheduler's writes through its deciding helper are not seen

mutations.name: AI14_a_decided_and_appended_write_is_decided
mutations.find: rows[key] = APPEND if APPEND in (mode, rows.get(key)) \
mutations.rationale: a function that appends one action outside the lock and also decides it is measured as decided
